risk_if_not_implemented: Without Use of Live Data, applications may be built and deployed with exploitable design and coding weaknesses that adversaries can leverage. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: De-Identification (Anonymization)
compensating_control_1.justification: De-Identification (Anonymization) (DCH-36) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Use of Live Data (TDA-18) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Protection
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of data protection controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Protection (DCH-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Use of Live Data (TDA-18) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability.
